privacy: RSVP information is used for wedding planning and shared only with authorised organisers

token.title: Your family token
token.help: Show this number at the venue. When it appears on the big screen, it is your family's turn for the stage and the blessings.
rsvp.joinUs: Join us — your blessings make the celebration complete.
ev.haldi.line: Come bathe in the golden glow of haldi — colour, laughter and blessings are waiting for you.
ev.haldi.meaning: May goodness and well-being come to all
ev.mehendi.line: Join us as henna paints the hands and love fills the air — stories, songs and sweet moments.
ev.mehendi.meaning: Auspiciousness in all that is auspicious
ev.sangeet.line: Sing, dance and celebrate with us — the evening is not complete without you.
ev.wedding.line: Walk beside us as we take the seven steps — your blessings make our vows complete.
ev.wedding.meaning: Take the seven steps with me, my friend
ev.reception.line: Raise a toast with us and bless our new beginning — we would be honoured by your presence.
ev.general.line: We would be delighted to have you with us.
ev.general.meaning: Salutations to Ganesha, remover of obstacles
token.pending: Your token number is issued when you check in at the venue with your phone number and code. It will appear right here.

trip.intro: Tell us how you are travelling and what you like to eat, so we can welcome you well. Everything here is optional and you can change it any time.
